stem: Kestrel Payments runs a public REST API on API Gateway and needs each free-tier partner individually limited to 5 requests per second while a separate paid tier gets a higher limit, without changing the backend service.

choices.text: Create separate usage plans with different throttle and quota settings tied to each partner's API key
Lower the account-level throttling limit for the Region to 5 requests per second
Lower the stage-level throttle settings on the production stage to 5 requests per second for every caller on that stage
Publish rate-limit guidance in the API documentation for partners to follow

rationale: Usage plans tied to API keys let each partner tier get its own throttle and quota, which is the only option here that gives free-tier and paid partners different limits. Account-level and stage-level throttle settings apply uniformly to every caller, so neither can separate the two tiers. Publishing guidance for partners to follow has no enforcement, so it does not actually create the two tiers.
